svg.text: x — the prompt: the template's control tokens, the roles, the user's turn, and the assistant header
y — the response, including its end token
amber = a control token (W2 p22): in the vocabulary, never reachable from text

g.text: the end token never in the loss → the model never learns to stop; it writes until max tokens
a different template at inference than in training → a prefix it has never seen (W2 p22: each family has its own)
a control token the base never trained → its embedding row is noise, and LoRA does not touch embeddings (p22)
